scope: official Creators API read-only SearchItems, GetItems, and GetVariations contract

authentication.blocker: No approved Creators API Credential ID/Secret/version and caller-owned PartnerTag were supplied to this execution.

catalog.product_variations.boundedCollector: getAllVariations caps at ten sequential pages, verifies child/parent ASIN family binding, detects duplicate ASINs and summary drift, and reports incomplete enumeration

documentedFieldAvailability.description: unavailable: no dedicated long-description resource in current ItemInfo schema
documentedFieldAvailability.featuresAndProductAttributes: available in requested ItemInfo resources; captured in local fixtures only
documentedFieldAvailability.images: available: primary and variant small/medium/large with dimensions; captured in local fixtures only
documentedFieldAvailability.options: available through GetVariations child ASIN attributes; captured in local fixtures only
documentedFieldAvailability.identifiers: available: ASIN/parent ASIN and optional EAN/ISBN/UPC/itemPartNumber; seller SKU unavailable
documentedFieldAvailability.priceAndAvailability: available through OffersV2; availability and order limits do not equal exact on-hand stock
documentedFieldAvailability.customerReviewScoreCountBodiesPhotos: unavailable: no current Creators API customer-review resource documented

variationIntegrity.directRequestedAsinInReturnedItems: family binding verified against exact ASIN; parentAsin remains null if API omitted it
variationIntegrity.requestedParentAsinMatchesReturnedChildr: family binding verified from returned parentASIN values
variationIntegrity.requestedChildAsinNotInCurrentPage: GetItems resolves the requested ASIN parentASIN before accepting a common returned family
variationIntegrity.crossPageDuplicateAsinsOrSummaryDrift: items are deduplicated for collection output, integrity issue recorded, complete=false
variationIntegrity.completeRequires: all reported pages, stable pageCount/variationCount, unique child ASIN count equal to variationCount, verified family binding and no API partial errors

priceSemantics.offerScope: Featured offer listings only; not all sellers or legacy Offers.Summaries
priceSemantics.currencyOfPreference: Caller may supply a documented ISO 4217 preference; returned offer currency is preserved.

pagination.pageRunner: SearchItems sequential pages are bounded by the API at ten. GetVariations uses API pageCount and the collector caps one run at ten pages. `complete=true` requires consistent summary counts, unique child ASINs, bound family membership and no partial API errors; otherwise it reports incomplete/inconclusive. No automatic retries.
